_comment: Synthetic edge cases (extraction_context.md task 3) for gaps the MTSamples set may not cover. `expected` was drafted by Claude, grounded in policy already decided in extraction_context.md's 'Open labeling decisions' section and the existing prompt rules (v2's destination-naming rule, the closed TOPICS vocabulary) - not new judgment calls. Spot-check before treating as final ground truth. The other two items in that same 'Open labeling decisions' list are genuinely undecided policy questions, not something to guess here: does 'weightbearing as tolerated' map to full, or get no tag; does 'nursing home' map to SNF. Add cases for those once Nicole decides and writes the rule into the prompt.

items.trap: isolation precautions lifted -> none, not silence
items.text: Contact precautions discontinued as of this AM per Infection Control; no isolation precautions required at this time.

items.trap: fluid restriction, an underrepresented topic in the prototype set
items.text: Continue strict fluid restriction, 1.5 liters per 24 hours, for volume management.

items.trap: conditional hold pending labs, phrased differently than the prototype's Margaret note
items.text: Hold enoxaparin dosing until repeat hemoglobin is resulted; will reassess once labs return.

items.trap: family wish, not an order -> no destination tag
items.text: Family expressed hope that he can return home once he is stronger, though no specific timeline was discussed.

items.trap: discharge-ready but no place named -> no destination tag (v2 prompt rule)
items.text: Patient is medically ready for discharge; case management is still arranging transport.

items.trap: past-tense hospital-course statement, not an active instruction
items.text: Diet was advanced to regular during the prior shift without complication.

items.trap: 'continue IV fluids' has no Baton-recognized value (fluids is only restrict/encourage)
items.text: Continue IV fluids at the current maintenance rate overnight.

items.trap: generic advice with a decoy word - 'encourage' here is not fluids:encourage
items.text: Encourage ambulation in the hallway twice daily and deep breathing exercises to prevent atelectasis.
